tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List every PRIVAKU app and SDK (Photos, Talk, Agent Shield, Eye, Brain SDK, Infinite, OnDevice SDK, Action AI) with slug, status, platforms and page URL.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full facts for one PRIVAKU product: summary, features, status, price, platforms, notes and official links. Accepts a slug from list_products or a common name (e.g. 'photos', 'talk', 'agent-shield', 'brain').

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Keyword search across every page in the privaku.com sitemap. Returns page titles, URLs and short snippets.

tools.name: get_privacy_policy_summary
tools.description: The privaku.com privacy policy: short version, each section's text, last-updated date, per-app policy links and contact.

tools.name: list_free_tools
tools.description: The free PRIVAKU browser tools (translate, photo privacy check, remove photo location, screenshot to text, reduce photo size, image to PDF). They run in the browser; files are not uploaded.

tools.name: get_download_links
tools.description: Official App Store, Android beta, web and Mac/SDK download links exactly as published on privaku.com. Optionally filter by product slug.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search privaku.com pages. Returns {results:[{id,title,url}]}; pass an id to fetch for the full page text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the text of one privaku.com page by the id (its URL) returned from search or search_site.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
